body.title: Runner, step list and expected version
body.summary: In src/daemon/repo-settings.ts add REPO_CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION (1), the SchemaMigrationStep and SchemaMigrationResult types, the static step list whose version-1 step runs migrateBuildDefaults over the listed repos and is clean only when counts['write-failed'] is 0, and runSchemaMigrations(deps): read the version, run each pending step in ascending order, stop at the first that is not clean or throws, stamp the highest clean version through writeSchemaVersion, return a status (applied, up-to-date, newer-schema, not-clean, registry-unreadable, file-unreadable, schema-version-invalid, failed) and never reject. migrateBuildDefaults and the repo.buildDefaults.migrate handler are consumed unchanged. Update inventory fixtures only for what this task adds. Tests in schema-migrations.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: runSchemaMigrations runs the pending steps in ascending order and stamps the highest clean version for a version that is absent, null or below the expected one, runs nothing for an equal or higher one, stops at the first step that throws or reports write-failed and stamps only the earlier clean version, runs nothing on an unreadable file or an invalid version, reports registry-unreadable when the registry cannot be listed, and never rejects
the version-1 step runs migrateBuildDefaults over the listed repos and is clean only when no repo reports write-failed
two successive runs over a temporary Python repo with no commands and no schemaVersion write the three keys and stamp 1 the first time and run nothing the second time, with no commit id read anywhere
a command cleared after the stamp is not re-applied by the second run while the manual repo.buildDefaults.migrate handler still re-applies it and leaves schemaVersion unchanged
